purpose: Server-rendered management surface for governed QA customer accounts (test users).
ownedConcepts: Test user list with active status, test order counts, and creation timestamps
Governed test user create request flow (test-user-management CREATE, entityKey = email)
Governed test user delete request flow (test-user-management DELETE, entityKey = customerId)
Pending-review chips for create and delete requests keyed by entityKey
One-time OTP reveal with copy affordance
businessRules: List reads hit SHRESTA-BE directly; create and delete never mutate records and instead submit change requests approved at /admin/review.
The OTP is minted by the backend at approval time, stored only as a hash, and is never collected by any form or present in any change-request payload.
The OTP is revealed exactly once via the reveal endpoint; after reveal the list reports otpRevealed true and the reveal button disappears.
Mobile, when present, must be a 10-digit Indian number; email is normalized to lowercase.
Test user management is restricted to SUPER_ADMIN, CHANGE_MANAGER, and CHANGE_ADMIN roles.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render AdminApiUnavailable instead of the Next runtime overlay.
